# Natural Healthy Village Kaengkrachan

> Exclusive residential land for sale in Kaengkrachan, Phetchaburi, Thailand — ~2.5 hours from Bangkok. Private lake with chapel island, 360° mountain views, 12+ rai common green space, Chanote title deeds. Six plots remaining (from 16 total), priced 2,500,000–7,000,000 THB. English/French: 081 860 4501. Thai: 095 365 2500. Email: kaengkrachan.village@proton.me

## Key facts

- Languages: the site is published in English, French (/fr/) and German (/de/). Enquiries are answered in English and French only.
- Type: residential land for sale. Not a resort, hotel or lodging business; no accommodation is offered.
- Location: Kaeng Krachan, Phetchaburi Province, Thailand. Coordinates 12.906965, 99.7188683.
- Distance (straight line from the coordinates above): about 46 km to Hua Hin, 29 km to Cha-am, 33 km to Phetchaburi town, 127 km to Bangkok. Road journey from Bangkok is about 2.5 hours.
- Nearest landmarks: 1 km to Khao Kling mountain, 4 km to the Kaeng Krachan National Park entrance.
- Availability: 6 plots remain of 16 total.
- Plot sizes: 1,070 m2 to 2,824 m2.
- Prices: 2,500,000 THB to 7,000,000 THB. Plot 1 1,396 m2 3,500,000 THB; Plot 2a 1,070 m2 2,500,000 THB; Plot 3 2,056 m2 5,000,000 THB; Plot 6 2,824 m2 7,000,000 THB; Plot 9 2,324 m2 6,500,000 THB; Plot 16 2,164 m2 5,400,000 THB.
- Title: every plot holds a Chanote title deed. Thai nationals may buy freehold; foreign nationals may hold a registered 30-year renewable lease.
- Common land: more than 12 rai, including a private lake with a chapel island.
- Utilities: three-phase power, underground cabling, deep well water, solar.
